external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The Department of One Foreign Language and IT Based Marketing Communication has recently signed an agreement with Kiel University of Applied Sciences for the development of a BA double degree. It is the first in the history of University College South Denmark.
University College South Denmark are involved in many international projects (Comenius, Erasmus+, Nordplus, Interreg, etc.) and also offers a number of courses in English.
